incident-bot: 🚨 ALERT: GPU pool 'pool-v15' exhausted and request queueing increased above threshold. Autoscaler failed to add nodes — hit pool max. Paging SRE oncall.

kevin: on it. Paging reason? any recent deploys?

maria: @kevin yes, we rolled v15.2 to hosted yesterday with prefill/warmup enabled for short responses -> but we've had reports of longer context runs hitting 20k tokens.

kevin: ok. grabbing autoscaler logs and pool metrics now. `redwood autoscaler status --pool pool-v15 --since 15m`

kevin: ```
[00:42:10] pending_requests=842
[00:42:11] active_gpus=64
[00:42:11] max_pool_gpus=64
[00:42:11] scale_out_attempts=6
[00:42:11] last_scale_out_failed=true
[00:42:11] failure_reason=quota_limit
[00:42:11] avg_context_len_tokens=18000
[00:42:11] kv_cache_entries=+3.9x
```

tony: ugh kv-cache growth. v15.2 changed tokenizer padding and introduced prefill sequences for completion conditioning — warms KV and increases memory per session. We didn't expect avg context >12k.

anita: any errors returned to customers?

kevin: yes, 5xx rate spiked to 7% over last 10m, latency P95 went from 140ms -> 1.8s; many requests queued and then throttled.

sara: CS reporting two enterprise customers seeing timeouts and elevated error rates (AcmeHealth, NovaChat). Escalating.

maria: immediate mitigation proposals: 1) disable prefill/warmup for v15.2 (config flag) 2) reroute traffic for high-ctx routes to v14-compact 3) manual eviction of low-priority pools to free up GPUs 4) temporary increase pool max if cloud quota allows.

kevin: attempting (1) now. `redwood models update v15.2 --set prefill=false --env production`

kevin: (logs) `update accepted. rolling config change.`

tony: If prefill is disabled it will stop warming KV for new sessions but existing sessions still hold large caches. We should also trigger a KV TTL purge for sessions idle >5m. I'll run a targeted purge on this pool.

tony: `runtime admin purge-kv --pool pool-v15 --idle-seconds 300`

anita: are we able to failover specific customer routes to dedicated pools? AcmeHealth has dedicated capacity in eu-west.

maria: yes, routing policy can send AcmeHealth to dedicated fallback. Doing that for the next 5 min while we stabilize. `routes update --customer AcmeHealth --target dedicated-eu-west`

kevin: autoscaler still hitting quota when trying to add nodes. Cloud team confirmed quota bump will take ~2 hours. Cannot rely on that for immediate.

kevin: current effect after prefill disable + kv purge: pending_requests down to 420, 5xx down to 3.2%, P95 620ms. Improvement but still above SLO.

maria: next step: roll back v15.2 to previous v15.1 for the public rollout while we investigate tokenizer/prefill regression. Rollback ready?

tony: I can trigger a partial rollback for non-enterprise routes now. Command: `deploy rollback v15.2 --to v15.1 --scope public --max-in-flight 100`

kevin: initiating rollback. Monitoring.

incident-bot: NOTE: on-call handoff at 03:00Z scheduled. Please add handoff summary.

maria: adding handoff. Summary: GPU pool pool-v15 exhausted due to v15.2 rollout with prefill enabled + unexpected increase in average context length (~18k tokens) -> KV cache growth x3.9 -> autoscaler hit pool max and failed to scale (quota). Immediate mitigations: disabled prefill, purged idle KV entries, routed affected enterprise customer(s) to dedicated pools, initiated rollback of v15.2 for public traffic. Current status: pending_requests 210, 5xx 1.1%, P95 320ms.

anita: CS notified AcmeHealth + NovaChat; issuing interim incident notice. Anita to own customer comms.

sara: for postmortem: should include - reason longer contexts started (prompt template change?) - model change that enabled prefill by default - missing autoscaler quota guardrails and escalation path - add automated route failover for high-impact customers - add test for KV growth in rollout canary.

tony: also we should add a runtime limiter: cap KV entries per session and fallback to truncation when context >12k. I'll file a PR after stabilization.

kevin: final status check: `redwood autoscaler status --pool pool-v15` -> pending_requests=42, active_gpus=64, avg_ctx=9200, kv_cache_growth stabilized.

maria: taking over incident lead for handoff to next oncall (maria -> kevin) at 03:00Z. kevin, please carry through postmortem draft.

kevin: will do. I'll also prepare the incident timeline and collect metrics for 2 hours before/after rollout.

anita: next steps for CS: send targeted note to affected customers with ETA for remediation and mention automatic rollback was performed.

maria: tagging for follow-ups: #postmortem #runbook-update #quota. Action items: Tony to PR runtime KV cap, Kevin to draft postmortem + metrics, Maria to coordinate cloud quota process, Anita to finalize customer comms, Sara to update rollout checklist to require KV growth test.

kevin: signing off initial page. will update thread with postmortem link.

maria: thanks everyone. Closing active paging. ``
